name: Arithmetic Obfuscation of Inequality
description: Replaces the standard inequality constraint (p_u != p_v) with an arithmetically equivalent condition on the domain {1, 2, 3}: that their product must not be a perfect square. This prevents models from immediately pattern-matching the problem to graph coloring, disabling their graph-specific search heuristics like degree-ordered backtracking and forcing them to either reinvent the heuristic or TLE on generic search.
